result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B sets the incident text at about 16px with generous line spacing, and stacks each date, title and body as separate lines, so each part is easy to pick out. Its uptime figures use a monospaced face and are right-aligned, so they line up cleanly. A is tidy and legible, but its incident body is smaller and dimmer gray, its date sits off to the side in small print, and its percentages use proportional bold digits, so they line up less precisely. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both pages use a similar off-black background and system fonts, and both have clear text hierarchy. A sets the uptime figures in monospace so the digits line up for comparison, and its incident body text is larger (about 17px) with clear spacing between date, title and body. B is a bit cleaner because it shows the uptime label once instead of on every row, but its incident text is smaller (about 15px) and its bold, right-aligned figures may use proportional digits.
